episodes.title: A New Life
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion are seperately sent off to a new life in the city by their respective parents. Apple is to find an apartment that is ready for him through a map, while Onion has free housing waiting through his job at Fun Co. Upon making it to the city, the two find that what can go wrong will go wrong, and eventually find their journies intertwined.

episodes.title: The Perfect Team
episodes.summary: During a computer game-playing session, "perfect team" Apple and Onion find themselves with a new roommate pawing at their window: a cat. It loves to roost upon Apple's head, but seems to hate Onion because of his hair; causing tension between who spends more time with Apple.

episodes.title: Tips
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion desire to be on a balloon ride, they gather all the change they can but it's not enough. Desperate to get on the ride, they work to get tips from customers at the pizza place where Pizza works, they start to scare off customers, but then realize they need to do this by being polite to the customers.

episodes.title: Falafel's Fun Day
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion decide to show their landlord Falafel an amazing day when he starts to feel homesick and after getting him mad when they didn't listen to his warnings about the air conditioner, things don't go the way they intended however.

episodes.title: 4 on 1
episodes.summary: When Burger and Hot Dog notice Onion has some pro basketball skills, they decide to ask if him and Apple would be interested to join their team for the big 4 on 4 tournament, they accept, but Onion starts to lose for the team when he finds the voices in his head keep throwing him off and making him nervous.

episodes.title: Apple's in Trouble
episodes.summary: Apple is challenged to a fight by a grumpy Cheesesteak after Apple yells at Lemondrop, so he and Onion go on a quest to find the source of Cheesesteak's grumpiness by using the clues for a "chain reaction". This quest starts from the hotel, then into a room, then into a kitchen, then into the sewers, then into another room, then into Edwards School.

episodes.title: Hot Dog's Movie Premiere
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion are banned from the premiere of their friend Hot Dog's new movie he's in: Robotot II, so they try many attempts to sneak in. Their plans involve hiding in Popcorn to get in the bathroom so they can get into the booth, using objects to fool Chicken Nugget (a police-guard), disguising themselves as dogs, and using dipping sauce.

episodes.title: Bottle Catch
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion invent a new game called bottle catch (tossing a water bottle back and forth). When Energy Bar hears about it, she steals the idea. In order to get everyone to buy the many water bottles they need to sell, they try to interest them in the bottles by having a bottle catch contest against Energy Bar and Whey.

episodes.title: Pancake's Bus Tour
episodes.summary: When Apple loses his shoe, Onion takes him on a guided bus tour to a shooting star show to have him wish for his shoe. But on the bus, Apple must learn to try and stay serious so they won't get kicked off the bus.

episodes.title: Block Party
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion are getting ready for a block party with all their friends, but a mischievous duck takes over their roof. When they are unable to get into the house because they're stuck with the duck, they try to outwit it before the cake they baked for the party melts and destroys their laptop, which holds the song they wrote for the party.

episodes.title: Apple's Focus
episodes.summary: Apple helps Onion achieve his dream of competing on a baking show.

episodes.title: Lil' Noodle
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion must remain legit enough to be in their favorite rapper's music video.

episodes.title: Gyranoid of the Future
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion struggle to ride Gyranoid of the Future, the craziest roller coaster at the carnival.

episodes.title: Fun Proof
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion want to become this week's "Most Fun People".

episodes.title: Whale Spotting
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion need to join an exclusive club to see a rare whale.

episodes.title: Heatwave
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion try to spread cheer during a city-wide heatwave.

episodes.title: Apple's in Charge
episodes.summary: Apple is put in charge of the Dollar Store for the very first time.

episodes.title: Burger's Trampoline
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion must find a way to use Burger's trampoline without making him feel used.

episodes.title: Baby Boi TP
episodes.summary: Apple needs to acquire a lifetime supply of toilet paper to finish his modern art sculpture.

episodes.title: Not Funny
episodes.summary: With their 6 month friend anniversary approaching, Apple has to find a way not to lose his best friend.

episodes.title: Onionless
episodes.summary: Apple tries to survive a weekend alone while taking care of Onion's plant.

episodes.title: Party Popper
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion's party plans are interrupted by a grumpy guest.

episodes.title: Face Your Fears
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion must face their fears while trapped in a pet shop, so they can save French Fry from facing hers.

episodes.title: Apple's Short
episodes.summary: Apple needs to be tall so that he can be in love.

episodes.title: Positive Attitude Theory
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion spend a day in Falafel's shoes and use their positive attitude to prove he shouldn't be so grumpy.

episodes.title: Follow Your Dreams
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion need to find a dream to follow, so that their lives don't head nowhere.

episodes.title: Sausage & Sweetie Smash
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion must conquer their obsessions of sausages and a video game.

episodes.title: Selfish Shellfish
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion have to prove that they're not selfish when they do their good deeds.

episodes.title: Apple's Formula
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion a pair of childlike newcomers to the big city attempt to fit in to their new surroundings.

episodes.title: River of Gold
episodes.summary: The duo become obsessed with reading an old book on display at the museum. But Chicken Nugget has to guard the book in order to get his police job back.

episodes.title: Appleoni
episodes.summary: The duo make up a new dance, but Burger steals the credit when he gains fame doing the dance with one modification.

episodes.title: Falafel's in Jail
episodes.summary: Falafel is arrested for a string of headset robberies. Apple and Onion feel so convinced of his innocence that they make repeated attempts to break him out of jail.

episodes.title: The Music Store Thief
episodes.summary: Someone is stealing instruments from Ice Tea's music store, right under the nose of Chicken Nugget, who moonlights there as a security guard. Apple and Onion love the store so much that they volunteer to help catch the thief.

episodes.title: The Fly
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion must get a fly out of their apartment or Falafel will kick them out.

episodes.title: Dragonhead
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion start a secret city parking lot to raise money for a new shower head.

episodes.title: Pulling Your Weight
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion start taking workout lessons at the city gym in order to get strong enough to save each other's life.

episodes.title: Rotten Apple
episodes.summary: Onion's dad comes to the city to visit but thinks Apple is a bad influence on Onion.

episodes.title: The Inbetween
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion get lost beneath their floorboards and must find a way out.

episodes.title: Election Day
episodes.summary: Apple runs for Mayor.

episodes.title: Champion
episodes.summary: This season Apple and Onion are finding adventure and new friends around every corner. With their boundless enthusiasm and wild imaginations, they'll have to defend their roof shack before it's overrun by vermin and brambles, protect their special booth at Pizza's Diner, and try to become one-hit-wonders so they'll never have to work a day in their lives again.

episodes.title: Falafel's Passion
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion must stop Falafel from humiliating himself on a national TV show.

episodes.title: Hole in Roof
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion must repair the hole in their roof before the impending storm of the century.

episodes.title: Patty's Law
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion must look after a sick Falafel in order to go parasailing.

episodes.title: The Eater
episodes.summary: Apple & Onion take on a monster in a parallel universe in order to get back home.

episodes.title: Apple & Onion's Booth
episodes.summary: Apple & Onion must save their favorite booth at Pizza's Diner from a Texas oil tycoon.

episodes.title: Ferekh
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion have to get Falafel's beloved rooster back from scientists.

episodes.title: Pat on the Head
episodes.summary: Apple must unhypnotize Onion before they can cook for a very important guest.

episodes.title: Falafel's Glory
episodes.summary: Apple & Onion must win a trivia game to get the world's largest pizza.

episodes.title: Christmas Spirit
episodes.summary: Apple & Onion have to become mall Santas to get the gifts they want for Christmas.

episodes.title: Slobbery
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion have to get rid of Burger's roommate so Burger will help them.

episodes.title: Microwaves Dance Club
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion need more room in a packed nightclub in order to bust their dance moves.

episodes.title: All Work and No Play
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion build eye masks to sleep at work so they can have more time for fun.

episodes.title: Drone Shoes
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion need to find power to plug in their new drone shoes.

episodes.title: Walking On The Ceiling
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion need to get down from being stuck on the ceiling of a bridge.

episodes.title: Keep It Fresh
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion need to refrigerate a sandwich before it expires.

episodes.title: Panamanian Night Monkey
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion must become zebras to see their favorite monkey at the zoo.

episodes.title: Za
episodes.summary: To help Pizza's Diner, Apple and Onion give it a complete makeover.

episodes.title: Broccoli
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion must get Hoagie to finish replacing their building's roof so that they can get on with their lives.

episodes.title: Cousin's Day
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion have to sell a lot of Cousin's Day mugs before Patty gets back from vacation.

episodes.title: Nothing Can Stop Us
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion have to get Hot Dog his toupée before an important audition.

episodes.title: Good Job
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion need to get the building tenants to appreciate Falafel more.

episodes.title: One Hit Wonder
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion have to keep a couple together so they can sing their new love song at the couple's wedding.

episodes.title: A Matter Of Pride
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion quit their demeaning jobs at the Dollar Store as a matter of pride.

episodes.title: Eyesore a Sunset
episodes.summary: Art is subjective and Apple and Onion agree to let that get between them.

episodes.title: For Queen and Country
episodes.summary: Onion's unexpected and impossible new love interest results in a trip to England.

episodes.title: Petri
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion must get back to their apartment to put the lid back on a dangerous petri dish.

episodes.title: Lowlifes
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion cannot allow themselves to be viewed by society -- and more importantly by smug old Chicken Nugget -- as lowlifes.

episodes.title: Falafel's Car Keys
episodes.summary: Apple & Onion are deemed responsible enough to borrow Falafel's car for their first road trip together. Nothing will go wrong, and they're going to make sure of that… by getting some practise in.

episodes.title: Sneakerheads
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion need a Last Will and Testament if they are to protect their belongings from the state.

episodes.title: Filthy Rich
episodes.summary: What does it take to be truly content? Whatever it takes, Apple and Onion are going to achieve it.

episodes.title: Truffle Season
episodes.summary: It's truffle season, and Apple and Onion are truffle hunters and they will stop at nothing to taste a truffle.

episodes.title: Lambporcini
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion are very happy with their sweet new matching designer outfits they bought from known scam-artist Street Dog. That's until Chicken Nugget mistakes them for something they are not.

episodes.title: Jerk Chicken
episodes.summary: In pursuit of the American dream, Apple and Onion start their own business; however, a rather troublesome customer stands in their way.

episodes.title: Open House Cookies
episodes.summary: Jerk Chicken is selling his house and Apple and Onion have been showing a lot of interest which definitely has nothing to do with the delicious cookies out on offer.

episodes.title: World Cup
episodes.summary: It's time to relax in the expensive massage chairs that Apple & Onion have rented for the month. It's also time for the Football (soccer) World Cup and Falafel's team, Egypt is in the tournament.

episodes.title: Win It or Bin It
episodes.summary: Apple and Onion are about to take ownership of a brand-new luxury penthouse apartment and be rid of their roof shack forever. All they need is a good reference from a previous landlord: Falafel.
